text:
maria_csm: Quick heads-up — NorthGate (midmarket, Dedicated commit) showing a big drop in token usage over the last 10 days, onboarding tasks stuck at 60%. Renewal in ~45 days. Need a fast retention primer to avoid a downgrade.

jordan_csm: copying details: trial->paid Jan 5, ramped for 3 weeks then plateaued. main blocker looks like SSO flakiness + model choice mismatch for their nightly batch scoring job.

liyang_success: saw the same in the dashboard. health score fell from 82 -> 54. top signals: DAU down ~70%, 2 failed SSO attempts last week, 1 open support ticket about latency spikes.

ashley_csm: flagging for outreach. sketching a small winback play: 1) immediate SSO config assist, 2) short perf triage and config tweak, 3) offer 1-week Dedicated burst credit as courtesy. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria_csm: @liyang_success can you own the SSO session? @sam_engineer can you triage latency root-cause? ops_bot: create retention task.

ops_bot: Creating retention task RG-4321 — due in 3 days.

sam_engineer: on it — initial hunch is KV cache misses during batch runs leading to token regen and latency. I'll profile and post repro steps by EOD.

jordan_csm: messaging plan: short, human — 1) empathize, 2) offer 30min walkthrough, 3) propose temporary capacity bump, 4) agree on 3-week success criteria. I'll draft and post here.

liyang_success: scheduled SSO assist Wed 10am PT. I'll pre-check their IdP and capture required logs.

ashley_csm: Draft email (short): "Hi <Name> — noticed onboarding stalled. Can we do a 30min session to fix SSO, review perf, and enable a short trial mode with extra capacity?" Want to add a tailored usage snippet.

maria_csm: Good. Don't lead with downgrade talk. Instead use "safe rollback plan" + clear success criteria. Also capture immediate feedback during session.

jordan_csm: Also propose sending a 3-question micro-survey post-session to correlate subjective experience with metrics: 
- "Was the session helpful?"
- "Did latency improve for you?"
- "Remaining blockers?"

liyang_success: I'll add the micro-survey to the ticket flow and tag RG-4321.

sam_engineer: quick config suggestion if KV misses are root cause — enable prefix caching for their batch keyspace. snippet:
```
cache:
  prefix_cache_enabled: true
  ttl_ms: 120000
  max_entries: 10000
```
This should cut downstream regen and p95.

maria_csm: perfect. Objectives: first-touch triage + SSO session within 72h. Owners: @liyang_success (SSO & survey), @sam_engineer (perf triage), @jordan_csm (customer message), @ashley_csm (credit handling). ops_bot: set 72h reminder.

ops_bot: Reminder set for RG-4321 — check-in due 1718482799.

jordan_csm: Sending the customer note now. Will ask for availability and keep it under 3 lines. :rocket:

ashley_csm: finance ok with a one-time courtesy burst if it buys renewal. I'll add billing note to the ticket.

maria_csm: After the session we'll run a micro-eval: sample 10 representative prompts, record latency/quality, and confirm no quality regressions before changing model or quantization.

liyang_success: added micro-eval checklist to RG-4321: sampling prompts, latency baseline, target SLO p95 <= 200ms, and customer satisfaction q.

maria_csm: thanks team. update me after session. If they decline, plan B = targeted usage cadence + phased downgrade path with explicit cutoffs and outreach cadence.

jordan_csm: got it — message sent.

ashley_csm: :thumbsup:
